newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan blue chips soar, Fujitsu hits 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Japan blue chips soar, Fujitsu hits 1997 high.

text.p: Active buying continued to boost Japanese blue-chip shares in Tokyo early morning trading on Thursday, with Fujitsu Ltd extend Wednesday's gains to hit a high for this calendar year, brokers said.
As of 0017 GMT, Fujitsu rose 40 yen to 1,730 yen, a new high for this calendar year. Turnover was 5.10 million, the biggest volume on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.

Other blue chips also soared. As of 0022 GMT, consumer electronics giant Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd was up 50 yen at 2,420 yen, after hitting an intraday high for 1997 of 2,430. Its turnover was 2.82 million, the third-largest on the Tokyo bourse's first section, brokers said.

Top Japanese automaker Toyota Motor Corp grew 70 yen to 3,520 yen, while Honda Motor Co Ltd rose 40 yen to 3,700 on active investor purchases partly due to the approaching launch of individual stock options on the Tokyo and Osaka bourses on Friday, brokers said.
